newsitem.title: FRANCE: Latest massacres extend Algeria's bloodstains.
newsitem.headline: Latest massacres extend Algeria's bloodstains.

text.p: Suspected Moslem rebels killed up to 110 Algerian villagers overnight on Sunday and Monday south of Algiers. Here is a list of the worst massacres since early November last year. Unless stated otherwise, details come from Algerian newspapers.
Nov 3 - Moslem rebels kill 10 women, three children, cutting throats in Douaouda village near Algiers.
Nov 5 - Moslem guerrillas slaughter 31 people in Sidi el Kebit villlage 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, government says.
Nov 12 - Twelve villagers killed in Douar Ben Salah, authorities say.
Nov 13 - Eighteen villagers die in Medea province 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers, government says.
Dec 5 - Rebels kill 19 people in night raid at Benachour 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers.
Jan 4 - Rebels massacre 16 villagers in Benachour.
Jan 5 - Rebels kill 18 villagers in Douaouda hamlet southwest of Algiers, official statement says.
Jan 12 - Guerrillas kill 14 villagers in Tabainat in Blida province 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers.
Jan 14 - Nine bodies found in Djebel Koukou in Algiers and Bab Ali village near Algiers.
Jan 19 - Rebels kill 36 people in Sidi Abdelaziz 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers, authorities say.
Jan 23 - Rebels kill 15 villagers in Ali Baba south of Algiers, residents and newspapers say.
Feb 17 - Guerrillas hack to death 33 villagers in Kerrach hamlet 60 km (40 miles) south of Algiers.
April 5 - Guerrillas kill all 52 residents of hamlet in Medea province 70 km (45 miles) south of Algiers.
April 11 - Rebels kill 22 people in Menaa village near Boufarik 30 km (18 miles) south of Algiers, official statement says.
April 13 - Rebels slaughter 30 villagers in Chebli area 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, official statement says.
April 22 - Rebels hack to death 93 villagers in Bougara area, says government.
May 15 - Suspected rebels slaughter 30 people overnight at Chebli village in Blida.
June 23 - Suspected guerrillas cut throats of 18 people in Mouzaia area 60 km (40 miles) southwest of Algiers.
July 7 - Fifty-one civilians slaughtered in four attacks in Algiers and neighbouring province of Medea.
July 13 - Suspected militants kill at least 44 people in villages near Ksar el Boukhari southwest of Algiers.
July 23 - Suspected rebels kill 47, mostly by cutting throats, in two villages near Blida town during night.
July 26 - Thirty-eight villagers die in two hamlets in Blida region.
July 27 - Suspected Moslem militants massacre 44 people at night in hamlet near Larba, south of Algiers.
July 29 - Gunmen thought to be Moslem guerrillas kill more than 70 people in villages south of Algiers.
Aug 2 - Suspected rebels massacre over 80 people in Sidi el Madani in Blida, Matmata in Ain Defla province.
Aug 5 - Between 75 and 110 civilians reported killed in raids on villages in Blida and Ain Defla provinces.
